audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable ability interactions from missingInteractions were absent: Poppy's Keeper's Verdict (R) channel makes her untargetable, dodging burst spent into the cast; and Iron Ambassador (P) gives her a shield that absorbs the first burst thrown at her before she picks it back up.
audit.why: Both are decisive to all-in timing and were flagged as applicable-but-unmentioned for this exact matchup.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d (shield/engage timing) and dontsFull[2].d (don't dump burst into a fresh Iron Ambassador shield); breakdown.cooldowns now also carries the real Steadfast Presence cooldown numbers.

edits.before: - Poppy Steadfast Presence: matchup-defining — Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Unbreakable banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence sits on a 20s cooldown, 12s at rank 5 — track it: outside that window her dash-stop is gone and engage is clean. Keep Unbreakable banked for her Hammer Shock burst. Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1) is a fight decision, not a habit.
